changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.invoices ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, status varchar(10) NOT NULL, id_card bigint NOT NULL, id_financial_period bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT invoices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT invoices_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT invoices_card_period_key UNIQUE (id_card, id_financial_period), CONSTRAINT ck_invoices_on_status CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'PAID')), CONSTRAINT fk_cards_on_invoices FOREIGN KEY (id_card) REFERENCES registration.cards (id), CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_invoices FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_invoices_on_financial_period ON financial.invoices (id_financial_period);
